name: Lishenntser Lauros
original_name: リシュエンツェーリ・ラウロソ
source:
The sovereign of the Lauroso kingdom, a western neighbour of the Influss kingdom.

Very self-aware of her status and her abilities, she makes a grand entrance announcing herself to the fortress. Despite her arrogant nature and forceful personality, she does care for the welfare of her people and is decisive when disaster strikes her kingdom.

[Spoiler] As a ruler of one of the successor kingdoms to the once-great Inlux kingdom which held sway over all territory loyal to the Fiusia cult, she harbours a generations-old ambition to topple the larger Influss kingdom and to unite the human lands under one banner once more. To do this, she attempts to seize control of the fortress by kidnapping Avaro and forcing him into having sexual relations with her, whereby he is then obliged to marry into the Lauroso royal line which will allow Lishenzeri to claim the fortress as her property (regardless of what Fia has to say on this matter). Avaro's fidelity to Fia and the party's intervention prevent Lishenzeri's scheme from succeeding. She later joins the party after pledging loyalty to Fia as her master and lends aid in her personal capacity to the party cause. [/Spoiler]

A privileged upbringing bestows Lishenntser with many talents besides politics. She is even capable of cooking her kingdom's traditional dishes to a high standard as part of her palace training.
